article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 12 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Don Drysdale's Bullpen, Popeye the Sailor, Sonja Henie, and Jules Bledsoe
article-meta.kwd-group: Don Drysdale, Superga Air Disaster, Helen Stephens, Popeye The Sailor, 20th Century Fox Presents, Sonja Henie, Alice Faye, Fred Lowery, Guy Lombardo, The Lawless Twenties, Phil Spitalny, Jubilee, Jules Bledsoe, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 90 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 90 recovers and dates 12 historical broadcasts spanning syndicated sports lore, vintage comic strip radio serials, 1930s Hollywood musical previews, blind virtuoso whistling, prohibition crime history, and landmark African-American variety broadcasting: 3 sports history vignettes hosted by Hall of Fame pitcher Don Drysdale on ***Don Drysdale's Bullpen*** (including the tragic 1949 Superga plane crash that took the legendary *Grande Torino* football club, sprinter Helen Stephens' 1936 Berlin Olympic record, and Dub Jones' six-touchdown game), 2 early 1936 broadcasts of Floyd Buckley voicing the title sailor on ***Popeye the Sailor*** (NBC / Wheatena), 2 studio transcriptions from ***20th Century Fox Presents*** previewing Alice Faye in *Sing, Baby, Sing* and Olympic ice-skating icon Sonja Henie's feature debut *One in a Million*, blind whistler Fred Lowery on ***The New Fred Lowery Show*** (1945), Guy Lombardo's Royal Canadians (1946), prohibition true-crime on ***The Lawless Twenties*** (1955), Phil Spitalny's All-Girl Orchestra (1945), and pioneering baritone Jules Bledsoe ('Ol' Man River') hosting AFRS's landmark Black entertainment showcase ***Jubilee*** (1943).

sec.title: 1. *Don Drysdale's Bullpen* (1972)
sec.p: Hall of Fame pitcher Don Drysdale recounting legendary moments in international sports history:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Historical Event | |---|---|---|---| | `Don_Drysdale_Dub_Jones.mp3` | **"Don Drysdale's Bullpen: 'Dub Jones Didn't Quit - Six Touchdowns'"** | **1972-04-18** | Cleveland Browns back Dub Jones tying the NFL single-game scoring record. | | `Don_Drysdale_Superga_Crash.mp3` | **"Don Drysdale's Bullpen: 'The 1949 Superga Air Disaster & Torino FC'"** | **1972-04-25** | The May 4, 1949 plane crash claiming Italy's five-time champion football team. | | `Don_Drysdale_Helen_Stephens.mp3` | **"Don Drysdale's Bullpen: 'Helen Stephens - 1936 Olympic Gold at 11.5 Seconds'"** | **1972-05-02** | The 'Fulton Flash' dominating the 100m sprint at the Berlin Olympic Games. |
